# axm rules

Manage rules capabilities for configured agents.

## When to use

Use this command family when enabling or inspecting workspace instruction files.

## Usage

```bash
axm rules <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description                                                                    |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--scope` | choice | No       | Inspect project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](./global-flags).

## Examples

**Inspect instruction files**

```bash
axm rules
```

**Repair instruction-file drift**

```bash
axm lint --fix
```

## Subcommands

| Command                                 | Summary                             |
| --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| [axm rules enable](#axm-rules-enable)   | Enable instruction-file management  |
| [axm rules disable](#axm-rules-disable) | Disable instruction-file management |

### axm rules enable

Enable instruction-file management

```bash
axm rules enable [flags]
```

### axm rules disable

Disable instruction-file management

```bash
axm rules disable [flags]
```

## Requirements

- workspace

## Side effects

- mutatesWorkspace
- writesFiles
